evaluations.auditor_rationale: No Board or committee oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities is disclosed in the provided excerpt; the governance section is not included.
The CEO Q&A provides a high-level environmental performance update, but there is no explicit management role, accountability, or committee responsibility for climate.
The report identifies flaring regulation as a climate security trend and gas as a transition opportunity, but does not provide a quantified climate risk and opportunity assessment.
The report describes gas as a transition fuel and positions the business in the energy value chain, but does not quantify climate-related impacts on the business model or value chain.
No climate scenario analysis is disclosed in the provided excerpt; only a glossary reference to STEPS appears.
No climate risk integration into enterprise risk management is disclosed in the provided excerpt.

evaluations.verbatim_evidence_quote: commissioned several projects including the SIGP
evaluations.auditor_rationale: Specific mitigation projects such as SIGP and LPG are disclosed alongside onshore emissions reduction, but no adaptation measures are described.
The report provides onshore Scope 1 emissions intensity and a reduction figure, but no absolute Scope 1, Scope 2, or Scope 3 inventory and no group-wide boundary.
Extractive metrics such as production and reserves are provided, but the disclosure is not a complete SASB extractive metric set.

evaluations.auditor_rationale: A specific routine flaring target is disclosed, but there is no group-wide GHG reduction or net-zero decarbonisation target.
No methane measurement, reporting, verification, or environmental tracking disclosure is provided; only glossary terms such as LDAR and FVAR appear.
Specific flaring commercialisation projects and onshore routine flaring elimination are disclosed, but no spills data are provided.
No climate-related IAS 36 impairment or IAS 37 provision connectivity is disclosed in the provided excerpt.
No sustainability reporting boundary or alignment to the financial consolidation boundary is disclosed in the provided excerpt.
No ICSR or ISSA 5000 readiness disclosure is provided in the excerpt.

type_d_traps.auditor_rationale: No exact internal carbon price in USD/tCO2e is disclosed; IFRS S2 para 29(f) is absent.
No exact percentage of executive remuneration tied to climate KPIs is disclosed; IFRS S2 para 29(g) is absent.
